name: ONE DOWN TWO UPS
introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs straight up towards the ceiling and your hands at your sides. 

Lower one of your legs down. When you raise it up, lift your hips up off the floor. 

Return to the starting position. Switch to the other leg and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Squeeze your abs when raising up your hips.
Keep your arms relaxed by your sides, palms facing down.
Keep your hips stable and level.
Keep the other leg up towards the ceiling when lowering one leg down.
Exhale as you lift your hips, and inhale as you lower your leg.
It works on your rectus abdominis.
